title: EPOC
description: EEG dataset investigating neurophysiological correlates of Post-COVID-19 condition in adults recruited from the COVIDOM/NAPKON-POP cohort in Schleswig-Holstein. Participants (N = 98) with prior PCR-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection completed a battery of computerized cognitive tasks, including a psychomotor vigilance task, and a resting-state recording. Questionnaires on fatigue, anxiety, depression and sleep quality are included, and participants are grouped by presence or absence of self-reported cognitive symptoms. EEG recordings are missing for 3 participants (missing or corrupted files, or incomplete sessions).
methods_description: Single-visit laboratory study. Participants completed the Trail Making Test, then EEG was recorded with a 128-channel equidistant actiCHamp Plus system (Brain Products, Easycap cap) at 1000 Hz, with a nose reference, two EOG electrodes and impedances below 20 kΩ. They then performed four computerized cognitive tasks and a resting-state measurement, followed by questionnaires (FACIT-Fatigue, HADS, PSQI).
